notes.content: [p]We’ve implemented a complete class change system:[/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to view available classes[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented class change functionality, complete with visual (VFX) and sound effects (SFX)[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced item requirements to perform class changes[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/shorts/Z1R_h6ojPoE?feature=share"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Abilities & Actions Categories
notes.content: [p]Abilities have been split into three types: [b]Actions[/b], [b]Active Skills[/b], and [b]Passive Skills[/b], giving players more clarity and control over their builds.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283561/6dff8538a216976e63ab973286150dc2165fda64.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: First - Time Tutorial Feature
notes.content: [p]A simple in - game tutorial now appears automatically when starting the game for the first time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283561/3f2a063527ed2024c265a8b044bb1e9d4a11715f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Trade Shortcut Added
notes.content: [p]You can now request a trade with another player instantly by pressing [b]T[/b].[/p]

notes.title: Trading system update
notes.content: [p]Added system that allows trade items between players.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283561/82e27df7924a0d7d4c6fd4ec3bcc3652089019bc.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/8GSN3v8vN88"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Custom Idle & Locomotion Animations
notes.content: [p][b]Added new Idle and Locomotion animations built from scratch, replacing lower-quality Marketplace assets to ensure better character responsiveness and visual quality.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Control Rig Integration
notes.content: [p]A new Control Rig was created directly inside Unreal Engine, enabling smooth animation creation without relying on external tools like Maya or Blender.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283561/7f7ceadcf360c6e5db5370d24badedfe4450a792.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Buy and sell items
notes.content: [p]Added system that allows players to buy and sell items from NPCs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283561/7fbec0a88eb0497cac90f10f4e02a9fd338e8cf0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283561/ec48c786b635f9726ce8b039cea3f7f30ae46917.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/BVz2Kv1Ee8M"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Localization System Updated
notes.content: [p]We’ve improved our localization system to support English, Spanish and Russian languages.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283561/fdeeba6642fa3690f83f2214f101470bdf3f84a0.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: System Messages - Update
notes.content:
► When dealing damage to an enemy or you have taken damage, it will be displayed in the System Chat Box.

► When a new player connects, the name will be displayed in the System Chat Box.

► When a player is defeated by other player, a message will be displayed in the System Chat Box

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283561/d1ac30ef97b1e8b5948a3f0c964dd7eeb227ced3.png[/img]

notes.title: Party System
notes.content:
We’re excited to introduce the Party System – a new way to team up and conquer challenges together!
Players can now form parties to share bounties and experience from defeating monsters, making your journey even more rewarding.

► Invite Members — Players can invite others to join their party, strengthening their forces.
► Dismiss Members — Party leaders can remove members if needed, ensuring optimal teamwork.
► Change Party Leader — Pass the leadership role to any member for flexible group management.
► Leave Party — Members can exit the party anytime, keeping their independence intact.
► Drop Distribution Modes — Random and Finder keepers

► We have added a feature that checks for distance between players in order to be able to distribute experience and loot properly among party members.

► The Party Window was re-designed to match with the rest of the User Interface.

[previewyoutube=FC_NUVsb6lE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Implemented - NPC Entity
notes.content:
► The players are now able to interact with NPCs, which will display a set of options, these options will be filled later on with actions such as Teleport, Quest, Dialog, Buy or Sell Items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283561/ae3be3c5cacb11a553c2fee96d95e4f29cbef8d1.png[/img]

► While approaching to a NPC, it will play sounds or dialogs.

► Voice setting was included in the Sound Settings Tab inside the Settings Menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283561/b46bceac64e26f6b0c51dea0000a58fc9e1ae3c8.png[/img]

notes.title: Update - Zone Types Entity
notes.content:
This entity handles if players can damage each other depending on the zone that they are currently in.

For example we will not let players kill each other inside a city, but we allow it outside.

► Inside this system we also handle the soundtracks and display an onscreen message to
let the user know that has entered a new Zone.

► Handle what happens to the player when dying inside the zone, for example, respawn in
a new inside a safe zone.

[previewyoutube=GisblOW9hI8;full][/previewyoutube]
